profile.headline: Building AI Systems for Content Marketing & Business Automation | Agentic AI | Web Developer
profile.summary:
AI is becoming easy to access. The harder problem is figuring out how to turn it into something that actually improves your business. That's what I build: AI-powered systems that connect your data, software, and workflows to solve specific business problems and produce measurable results.

I specialize in AI-powered systems for content marketing and business operations. These systems can bring together information from your website analytics, YouTube, LinkedIn, email, CRM, customer reviews, and other sources to help you understand your audience, identify opportunities, create better content, and determine what actually converts—and why.

My approach combines software engineering, AI, data, analytics, and content marketing. Rather than simply adding another AI tool to your workflow, I look at the systems you already have and find opportunities to connect them, automate them, and make them more intelligent.

Too many businesses are investing in AI without a clear path to measurable results. The opportunity isn't necessarily to use more AI—it's to find the right problems to solve and build systems around them.

I can help you:
• Turn scattered business and marketing data into useful intelligence
• Discover audience pain points, needs, and content opportunities
• Build AI systems for content research, creation, and optimization
• Analyze what content is performing and determine why
• Connect AI to your existing tools, data, and workflows
• Automate repetitive marketing and business processes
• Build AI agents that can research, analyze, and take action
• Create measurement and feedback loops that continuously improve your systems

The goal is simple: build AI systems around real business objectives and measure whether they actually work.

If you're already collecting valuable data, using AI tools, or have business processes that seem like they should be automatable, let's talk about what might be possible.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description: At Hewlett Packard Enterprise, I spearhead full-stack development initiatives within the vLabs team, focusing on delivering robust educational services and tools. My role involves enhancing and maintaining a suite of applications critical to the IaaS-based infrastructure, managing public-facing web applications and websites, and providing both cloud-based and physical system access to a global user base.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Full stack development of AT&T's technical support system for universal agents and specialists.

Completed new feature requests, refactored preexisting code, performed bug fixes and other related coding tasks on time in a fast paced time critical environment. Contributed and interacted daily with a team of 20-25 developers where teamwork and collaboration was essential to meeting deadlines. Additionally worked on a 5 person scrum team where objectives were met over 2-3 week sprints.

All code committed (using git) went through a code review process where code quality was paramount. I also participated in QA testing of other team members code.

The team I worked on was also remote, so I collaborated with the existing team using video conferencing, team chat, screen shares, and other related technology.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
The division's Intranet is used by Scientists conducting nanoscience research and administrative users in support of those processes. Most of my work at Argonne was in support of this web application, committing code to the back end MVC system, the front end, and working with associated MySql databases.

Accomplishments included re-engineering the User Interface to replace legacy code, utilizing modern tools, coding best practices, and design patterns. Coding models, views, and controllers across the application which also included normalizing associated database tables. Coded several php scripts to connect to a soap based web service which automated tasks that had previously been done manually.Also, fixed bugs and added application features based on daily support tickets.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Devloper
positions.description: Department head of technology for the largest chamber of commerce publisher in the United States. Duties included full stack development for web applications and web sites. In this leadership role I also managed a team of web designers and was involved in all aspects of technology for the company including product ideas, web server administration, presenting at conferences, and representing the tech lead on sales calls.

patents.title: Method and apparatus for publishing a community based directory and of offering associated community based services
patents.description: This invention relates to a method or apparatus for publishing a community based directory and profile using a tangible and an intangible publication. The intangible publication consists of using at least two different digital communication protocols or using a fixed and a mobile device. Selected members listed in the community based directory are also able to access a list of digital services such as file storage, file transfer, electronic communications, management of information, marketing tools, etc. from the digital communication locations
